column2: Let us learn a friend trick! Watch what happens when the little beads run out.
Four little beads are up. The rod is full — there is no room for one more!
Here is the secret: little friends hold hands to make five. One and four are friends. Two and three are friends.
I want four plus one. No room? Then bring the big five-bead down.
Now send one's friend home — take the four little beads away.
Four and one makes five! One clean five-bead.
Your turn. You have four — add one. Bring the five down, send four home.
Yes! Four and one is five. You used a little friend!
Your right hand moves the beads, and it never rests on the frame. Stay ready.
Let us try three plus two. Three is up. Two's friend is three — five down, three home.
Now you. You have three — add two. Bring five down, send three home.
Five again! Two and three are friends too.
Look — one big five-bead at the bar. How many is that? Tap the number.
No rush. Let the beads do the thinking. Practice, practice, practice.
You learned the friends of five! High five!
